name: cdn-mcp-plugin
description: Operational know-how for uploading files to a personal CDN on Cloudflare R2 + Workers + D1. Installs the cdn-file-upload skill, which probes sandbox egress each session and adapts: with egress it uploads zero-click via signed R2 URL + direct PUT + finalize; without it, it generates a clickable script running the local cdn CLI. Any size or batch, never base64, filename sanitization and post-upload verification either way. Requires a deployed cdn-mcp Worker — see the plugin README.
